notes_list.title: Gattermann–Koch Formylation
notes_list.basic_overview: Aromatic compounds can be formylated using carbon monoxide and hydrogen chloride in the presence of Lewis-acid systems such as AlCl3/CuCl.
notes_list.extra_info_content:
The reaction introduces a formyl group directly onto an activated aromatic ring. It is an electrophilic aromatic substitution process involving a formyl electrophile equivalent.

MECHANISM & STEPWISE EXPLANATION
A Lewis-acid system generates a formyl electrophile from CO and HCl. The aromatic ring undergoes electrophilic substitution and work-up gives the aldehyde.
